en.title: Athletics World Championships 2031: World Athletics Championship to be held in Munich in 2031
en.summary: Munich will host the 2031 Athletics World Championships, with the city expecting costs around 110 million euros. This will be the third Athletics World Championship held in Germany.

en.title: Munich to host Athletics World Championships 2031
en.summary: Munich will host the 2031 Athletics World Championships, following its hosting of the European Championships in 2022.

stories.title: Leichtathletik: München wird Gastgeber der WM 2031

en.title: Athletics: Munich becomes host of 2031 World Championships
en.summary: The world athletics federation awarded the 2029 and 2031 World Championships, with 2029 being held in Africa for the first time and 2031 taking place in Munich.

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: Is Trump making AI support a new loyalty test?
en.summary: Trump opposes AI regulation, claiming a conspiracy favors China, while some Republicans oppose data center development.

stories.title: Ostsee: Russische Fregatte feuerte Leuchtkörper auf dänischen Hubschrauber

en.title: Baltic Sea: Russian frigate fired flares at Danish helicopter
en.summary: A Russian naval vessel discharged illumination rounds that narrowly missed a Danish military helicopter in the Baltic Sea. Denmark condemned the incident and summoned the Russian ambassador.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: »Das ist alles ein Hoax«, sagt Trump über den Handylautsprecher

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: "This is all a hoax," Trump says via phone speaker
en.summary: Donald Trump dismissed AI doomsday warnings during a phone call with Nvidia's chief at a conference, stating that strong and intelligent presidential leadership is all that is needed to address the technology.

stories.title: Russische Fregatte feuert Leuchtraketen auf dänischen Helikopter

en.title: Russian frigate fires flares at Danish helicopter
en.summary: A Danish military helicopter was nearly struck by illumination rockets fired from a Russian frigate. Denmark characterized the event as serious and summoned Russia's ambassador.

stories.title: Supreme Court: Niederlage für Trump im Streit um Briefwahl

en.title: Supreme Court: Trump loses dispute over mail-in voting
en.summary: The U.S. government's attempt to enforce stricter mail-in voting rules before November's midterm elections was rejected by the Supreme Court. Democrats expressed relief at the decision.

stories.title: US Supreme Court denies Trump bid to restrict mail-in ballots

en.title: US Supreme Court denies Trump bid to restrict mail-in ballots
en.summary: The US Supreme Court rejected Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting before the November midterms, determining that election officials lack sufficient time to implement such changes.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Supreme Court lässt Präsident im Streit um Briefwahl scheitern

en.title: Donald Trump: Supreme Court allows President to fail in dispute over mail voting
en.summary: The US Supreme Court rejected Trump's effort to restrict mail-in voting. The President faced setbacks in other legal proceedings and unfavorable polling numbers.

stories.title: Russland-Ukraine-Krieg: Nato-Kampfjets schießen Drohne über Litauen ab

en.title: Russia-Ukraine war: NATO fighter jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
en.summary: NATO fighter jets shot down a drone that entered Lithuanian airspace. President Nausėda attributed the incident to Russia's escalating aggression against Ukraine.

en.summary: As voters in the northeastern region prepare for elections, economic performance and future prospects are key issues. Data reveal major challenges facing the incoming government.

en.title: Dax now: Dax slides toward 25,000-point mark
en.summary: The German stock index declined further following weak opening trading. Rising bond yields, oil price increases, and artificial intelligence concerns pressured equity markets.

en.title: +++ Ukraine War +++: Despite Trump statement – Ukraine attacks Russian oil refinery
en.summary: Ukraine struck a Russian oil refinery amid ongoing conflict developments. Russia indicated no ceasefire during potential negotiations, and various military incidents occurred in the region.

en.summary: The government's cost-cutting measures are calculated to prevent an increase in average supplementary contributions to health insurance. However, experts caution that this calculation lacks adequate financial buffers.

en.title: Interview: Axa Chief Buberl: "The drivers of economic growth over the last 40 years have collapsed"
en.summary: The CEO of Axa calls for ending tax benefits for unhealthy food and outlines the company's strategy focused on preventive services, AI-driven growth, and serving small and medium-sized businesses.
